problems.title: Array Parity Partition Sum
problems.description:
Given an array of integers of size `N`, compute the absolute difference between the sum of all even integers and the sum of all odd integers.

### Input Format
- First line: Single integer `N`.
- Second line: `N` space-separated integers.

### Output Format
- Print the integer `|Sum(Even) - Sum(Odd)|`.

### Constraints
- 1 <= N <= 1000

problems.title: Vowel & Consonant Counter
problems.description:
Given a lowercase single-word string `S`, count the total number of vowels (`a, e, i, o, u`) and consonants present.

### Input Format
- Single string `S` (letters only).

### Output Format
- Print two space-separated integers: `<vowel_count> <consonant_count>`.

### Constraints
- 1 <= |S| <= 500

problems.title: Palindrome Substring Count
problems.description:
Given a single string `S`, count the total number of non-empty palindromic substrings of length >= 2.

### Input Format
- Single string `S`.

### Output Format
- Print integer count.

### Constraints
- 1 <= |S| <= 250

problems.title: Balanced Bracket Validator
problems.description:
Given a sequence of brackets containing `()`, `{}`, and `[]`, determine if the string is balanced.

### Input Format
- A single string of brackets.

### Output Format
- Print `YES` if balanced, or `NO` if unbalanced.

### Constraints
- 1 <= |S| <= 1000

problems.title: Matrix Spiral Layer Maximums
problems.description:
Given an `N x N` matrix, output the maximum element found along each concentric square border layer from outer perimeter inward to center.

### Input Format
- First line: `N`.
- Next `N` lines: `N` space-separated integers.

### Output Format
- Space-separated integers representing layer maximums from outer to inner.
